disclaimer: Templates document existing Baebugs source; they do not authorize or attest physical lab execution. Public sharing exposes only curated template IDs.

recipes.name: See every specimen
recipes.subtitle: Capture → measure → register a stable object identity.
recipes.scene: Three outlined specimens beneath a camera viewfinder

steps.title: Define specimen context
steps.detail: Choose an accession or a toy-analog ID; do not infer species identity.

steps.title: Inspect image scale
steps.detail: Bind the imaging setup to a ruler or calibration target; record calibration uncertainty.

steps.title: Prepare observation receipt
steps.detail: Record image SHA-256, context ID, bounding geometry and human review state.

recipes.rights_note: Software sources are MIT-declared in the repository; specimen photos retain their own media rights.

recipes.name: Design a gentler filter
recipes.subtitle: Compare round, slotted and variable openings without sacrificing source traceability.
recipes.scene: Interchangeable sieve disks and a sliding aperture plate

steps.title: Choose a frame and material
steps.detail: Identify tray interface and candidate steel/printed insert; dimensions require measurement.

steps.title: Select aperture geometry
steps.detail: Document nominal opening shape and mechanical capture assumptions.

steps.title: Record mechanical risks
steps.detail: Examine seams, burrs, appendage trapping and a reversible tray release.

recipes.rights_note: Baebugs CAD files carry the repository declaration; imported vendor meshes, material certifications and fabrication rights require separate review.

recipes.name: One drum, several fractions
recipes.subtitle: A modular hand-cranked trommel concept for observable analog sorting.
recipes.scene: Three perforated drum zones feeding collection bins

steps.title: Inspect source geometry
steps.detail: Select 2, 4 and 7 mm nominal drum zones and document material/fit.

steps.title: Define analog fractions
steps.detail: Identify dry proxy objects before sorting and photograph starting quantities.

steps.title: Request physical release review
steps.detail: Check guards, hand-drive torque, containment and specimen-damage boundaries before testing.

steps.title: Record retained fractions
steps.detail: Only record OBSERVED once actual measured before/after fractions exist.

recipes.rights_note: STLs are design evidence only; not an independently certified material or commercially exclusive invention.

recipes.name: Choose a preprocessing path
recipes.subtitle: Compare dispersal, settling and mesh stages in a clearly labeled virtual workflow.
recipes.scene: Wet-processing stations joined by specimen flow arrows

steps.title: Document input preservation
steps.detail: Identify wet/dry state and note fragility, wings and appendages.

steps.title: Review modeled stage alternatives
steps.detail: Explore hypothetical cross-flow, settling or dispersion without treating model output as measurement.

steps.title: Escalate reagent and fluid settings
steps.detail: Require safety and specimen-preservation authorization before physical use.

recipes.rights_note: BioKEA instrument concepts require upstream attribution; no licensed chemical/process performance is asserted.

recipes.name: Track the handoff
recipes.subtitle: Build a camera → filter → picker evidence route with explicit failure gates.
recipes.scene: Robot gripper approaching a labeled tray under a camera

steps.title: Check capture identity
steps.detail: Bind the target image and tray context to a single specimen candidate.

steps.title: Review reach and collision gate
steps.detail: Preserve the previously observed virtual 316.7 mm vs 300 mm reach failure.

steps.title: Request authorization
steps.detail: Do not drive the arm until an operator has approved and separately validated the motion.

recipes.rights_note: Robotic assembly/integration is not evidence of exclusive BioKEA hardware ownership.

recipes.name: Make modules labware-ready
recipes.subtitle: Select printed SBS adapters, tubes and a defined Flex protocol boundary.
recipes.scene: Tubes, plates and a small sieve cassette on a Flex deck

steps.title: Review labware definition
steps.detail: Inspect source geometry, SBS footprint and metadata against actual deck positions.

steps.title: Review printed adapter
steps.detail: Record polymer, manufacturing method and sample-contact restrictions.

steps.title: Keep robot protocol gated
steps.detail: Inspect simulated method independently; physical dispensing requires qualified operators and hardware.

recipes.rights_note: Opentrons interfaces have upstream Apache-2.0/trademark obligations; custom parts remain subject to contributor provenance.

recipes.name: Explore California collections
recipes.subtitle: Trace specimens to their source, collecting event and rights context.
recipes.scene: Magnifying glass over linked specimen collection cards

steps.title: Identify authoritative collection
steps.detail: Start from Calbug, Essig or DataONE without assuming each record is already ingested.

steps.title: Resolve source restrictions
steps.detail: Separate specimen record metadata from image rights and collection terms.

steps.title: Create intake proposal
steps.detail: Export proposed atom and external relationship before dataset admission.

recipes.rights_note: Source specimen photographs and databases carry separate rights and may not be redistributed.

recipes.name: Publish a contestable claim
recipes.subtitle: From observation to atom, typed graph, inclusion proof and independent challenge.
recipes.scene: Verified nodes and directed labeled connections

steps.title: Identify evidence source
steps.detail: Record exact bytes and source/context identifiers; hashes alone do not prove truth.

steps.title: Declare typed relationships
steps.detail: Bind claims and evidence with a named FCG edge; never infer causality from linkage.

steps.title: Generate and inspect proofs
steps.detail: Run the existing GitHub/CLI verification; do not invent an MMR commitment.

steps.title: Open contest route
steps.detail: Preserve the predecessor claim, attach rebuttal as successor FCO/FCG.

recipes.rights_note: The project declares MIT software; each scientific source remains governed by its own rights.

recipes.name: Audit the vision benchmark
recipes.subtitle: Compare domain holdouts while keeping pseudo-labels and lost weights visible.
recipes.scene: Side-by-side predicted masks with a warning marker

steps.title: Read frozen decision
steps.detail: Inspect AZ and OR exploratory teacher-agreement results and NV sample limitation.

steps.title: Audit partitions
steps.detail: Verify source-group separation and media identity overlap.

steps.title: Gate trained weights and truth
steps.detail: Do not promote lost weights or YOLOE pseudo-label scores as independent biological validation.

recipes.rights_note: Model toolchain, pretrained weights and museum images have separate license/attribution obligations.
